description: Reference-array literals and mixed-array rejection (CORE_MODEL_SPEC §4, §6). A literal made only of references is a reference collection carried through the bridge; scalar array literals remain ordinary arrays; mixed scalar/reference arrays are rejected under treecalc-v1 rather than coerced by the host.

cases.name: reference literal preserves source order
cases.note: Both entries are references resolved from the caller scope; the resulting reference collection preserves literal order.

cases.name: explicit reference literals preserve duplicates
cases.note: Navigation-produced collections do not duplicate nodes, but explicit reference literals preserve duplicate entries.

cases.name: reference literal is a set-valued reference
mixed reference/scalar array literal is rejected

expect.reason: TreeCalc v1 has scalar arrays and reference collections, but no mixed scalar/reference array value

cases.name: scalar array literal is value-valued, not a reference collection
